tool.name: 考勤验收
tool.description: 一款基于浏览器的考勤记录与验收单生成工具。用户可在线编辑考勤明细及验收评分，支持自动计算工作日并一键导出为格式规范、可直接打印的 Excel 文件，适用于外包项目管理与工时统计场景。
tool.descriptionEn: A browser-based tool for generating attendance records and acceptance certificates. Users can edit timesheets and evaluation scores online, automatically calculate working days, and export data into professionally formatted, print-ready Excel files, ideal for outsourcing project management and time tracking.
